name: Brightery Buy Now
author: Brightery

sections.description:
Brightery Buy Now adds a focused express-checkout flow to WooCommerce without replacing the checkout page or payment gateways.

The dedicated Buy Now action keeps only the product the shopper just selected in the cart and then redirects to checkout. The optional Add to Cart redirect keeps the existing cart intact and only skips the cart page.

Features:

  • Adds a dedicated Buy Now button to supported single product pages.
  • Supports simple products and selected variations on single product pages.
  • Adds a Buy Now action for simple products in classic shop and category loops.
  • Preserves the selected quantity when using Buy Now.
  • Removes unrelated cart items only when the dedicated Buy Now action is used.
  • Can optionally redirect normal successful Add to Cart actions directly to checkout without clearing the cart.
  • Supports classic WooCommerce add-to-cart behavior and the WooCommerce Blocks added-to-cart browser event for the optional redirect mode.
  • Uses WooCommerce and theme button styling.
  • Does not make external API requests.
  • Does not collect, transmit, or store customer personal data beyond normal WooCommerce cart behavior.
  • Does not modify WooCommerce order storage directly and declares High-Performance Order Storage compatibility.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the Brightery Buy Now ZIP file and activate it.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Brightery Buy Now.
  4. Configure the Buy Now button locations, button text, appearance, and optional Add to Cart redirect.

WooCommerce must be installed and active.
sections.faq:
What is the difference between Buy Now and the Add to Cart redirect?

Buy Now keeps only the product and quantity selected in that Buy Now action before sending the shopper to checkout. The optional Add to Cart redirect does not clear the cart; it only redirects a successful normal Add to Cart action to checkout.

Does Buy Now support variable products?

Yes. On a supported single variable-product page, the shopper selects a variation and quantity first, then uses Buy Now.

Does the plugin change checkout or payment gateways?

No. The plugin sends the shopper to the existing WooCommerce checkout and uses the payment and shipping methods already configured for the store.

Does the plugin send data to Brightery or another external service?

No. The plugin does not make external API calls and does not include tracking or telemetry.

What happens if WooCommerce is not active?

WordPress dependency handling prevents normal activation where supported. The plugin also includes a fallback administrator notice and does not run its WooCommerce functionality without WooCommerce.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added Buy Now express checkout for simple and variable products on supported single-product templates.
  • Added Buy Now for simple products in classic product loops.
  • Added optional direct-to-checkout behavior for normal Add to Cart actions.
  • Added WooCommerce HPOS compatibility declaration.
